title: Barramundi Tagine
description: A flavorful seafood stew originating from North Africa, made with barramundi and spices.

ingredients.name: tagine spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most middle eastern markets

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large clay pot or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add tagine spice blend and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add barramundi fillets and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until browned.
Add chopped apricots and cook for 1 minute.
Transfer pot to oven and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 12-15 minutes, or until fish is cooked through.
Fluff couscous according to package instructions.
Serve barramundi and sauce over couscous.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
